components.name: Primary Choice Button
components.description: The affirmative action that advances the invitation story.

components.name: Secondary Choice Button

components.name: Invitation Paper
components.description: The inset-framed sheet revealed from the envelope.
components.html:
有一场电影
想邀请你一起看

《去你的岛》
components.css: .ds-letter-paper { position:relative; overflow:hidden; width:306px; border-radius:16px; padding:28px 24px; color:var(--ink,#303954); text-align:center; background:linear-gradient(135deg,rgba(255,255,255,.98),rgba(248,249,255,.96)),var(--paper,#fbfcff); box-shadow:0 24px 62px rgba(68,77,124,.2); } .ds-letter-paper::before { position:absolute; inset:7px; border:1px solid rgba(144,153,190,.32); border-radius:11px; content:""; pointer-events:none; } .ds-letter-paper h2 { position:relative; margin:0; font-family:var(--font-noto-serif-sc),"Songti SC",STSong,serif; font-size:1.72rem; font-weight:500; line-height:1.42; letter-spacing:-.025em; } .ds-letter-paper p { position:relative; margin:18px 0 0; font-family:var(--font-noto-serif-sc),"Songti SC",STSong,serif; font-size:1.12rem; letter-spacing:.04em; color:#3f4968; } .ds-letter-corner { position:absolute; top:18px; width:18px; height:18px; border-top:1px solid #aeb6d1; } .ds-letter-corner-left { left:18px; border-left:1px solid #aeb6d1; } .ds-letter-corner-right { right:18px; border-right:1px solid #aeb6d1; } .ds-letter-divider { position:relative; width:78px; height:1px; margin:20px auto; background:linear-gradient(to right,#b9bfd7 0 41%,transparent 41% 59%,#b9bfd7 59%); } .ds-letter-divider i { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; width:6px; height:6px; transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(45deg); background:#8892bd; }

components.name: Sealed Envelope
components.description: The precise, floating first-viewport object and ceremonial opener.
components.css: .ds-envelope { position:relative; display:block; width:340px; height:225px; border:0; border-radius:0 0 16px 16px; padding:0; background:transparent; cursor:pointer; perspective:900px; } .ds-envelope-back { position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:0 0 16px 16px; background:linear-gradient(150deg,#cbd6f3,#bfc9eb 62%,#b8bee3); box-shadow:0 28px 54px rgba(61,70,119,.24); } .ds-envelope-flap { position:absolute; z-index:3; left:0; top:0; width:100%; height:52%; clip-path:polygon(0 0,100% 0,50% 100%); background:linear-gradient(170deg,#e5eafb 0%,#c7d2ee 72%,#bac5e7 100%); filter:drop-shadow(0 7px 8px rgba(61,71,118,.1)); transition:transform .48s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); transform-origin:top; } .ds-envelope-pocket { position:absolute; z-index:2; inset:0; border-radius:0 0 16px 16px; clip-path:polygon(0 17%,50% 66%,100% 17%,100% 100%,0 100%); background:linear-gradient(34deg,#bbc6e8 0 49.4%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(-34deg,#c9d3ef 0 49.4%,transparent 50%),linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 28%,#bdc7e8 29% 100%); } .ds-envelope-seal { position:absolute; z-index:4; left:50%; top:46%; display:grid; width:48px; height:48px; place-items:center; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); border-radius:999px; background:linear-gradient(145deg,#737fb4,#59669e); box-shadow:0 7px 16px rgba(51,60,103,.28),inset 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,.16); } .ds-envelope-seal i { width:15px; height:15px; transform:rotate(45deg); border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.9); border-radius:3px 8px 3px 8px; } .ds-envelope:hover .ds-envelope-flap { transform:rotateX(-5deg); } .ds-envelope:active { transform:scale(.99); } .ds-envelope:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #6c78b4; outline-offset:4px; }

components.name: Movie Cover
components.description: A replaceable 3:4 cinematic artifact inside the invitation.
components.css: .ds-movie-cover { position:relative; overflow:hidden; width:138px; aspect-ratio:3 / 4; border-radius:14px; background:#dce5fa; box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(58,67,110,.22); } .ds-movie-cover-art { position:absolute; inset:0; background:#dce5fa; transition:transform .7s; } .ds-movie-cover::after { position:absolute; inset:0; content:""; background:linear-gradient(to bottom,rgba(255,255,255,.1),transparent 50%,rgba(45,53,95,.12)); pointer-events:none; } .ds-movie-cover:hover .ds-movie-cover-art { transform:scale(1.025); }

components.name: Finale Film Mark
components.description: The projector-lit film symbol used to close the story without returning to card chrome.
components.css: .ds-projector-halo { display:grid; width:96px; height:96px; place-items:center; border-radius:999px; background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(255,255,255,.98) 0 38%,rgba(210,219,248,.7) 70%,transparent 72%); box-shadow:0 22px 50px rgba(85,94,143,.16); } .ds-film-mark { position:relative; display:block; width:39px; height:31px; border:2px solid #626e9f; border-radius:7px; } .ds-film-mark i,.ds-film-mark b,.ds-film-mark em,.ds-film-mark strong { position:absolute; width:4px; height:4px; border-radius:1px; background:#7b86b3; } .ds-film-mark i { left:5px; top:5px; } .ds-film-mark b { right:5px; top:5px; } .ds-film-mark em { left:5px; bottom:5px; } .ds-film-mark strong { right:5px; bottom:5px; }

narrative.overview:
This system makes a personal invitation feel like cinematic correspondence discovered in a quiet, self-contained world. Mist-blue paper, violet ink, and exact envelope construction make the interaction ceremonial without turning it into a generic romantic card. The mood is gentle, minimal, and refined; intimacy comes from restraint, sequence, and material detail rather than hearts, roses, or decorative sentimentality.

The experience follows one small narrative arc: open the sealed letter, choose the movie, ask to walk home, and remember the promise. Its first viewport belongs to one floating sealed envelope and a quiet prompt. Later surfaces retain the same paper, ink, ticket, and film vocabulary so the three routes read as chapters of one correspondence.
keyCharacteristics: Mist-blue and pale-violet atmosphere with white paper at the center.
Violet-blue ink instead of black, pink, or red.
Song-style serif display text paired with a restrained Chinese sans serif.
Precise envelope folds, inset rules, diamonds, film perforations, and hairline marks.
Soft ambient depth and slow, purposeful reveals.
One obvious affirmative action with a playful, non-coercive refusal interaction.

rules.name: The Violet-Ink Rule
rules.body: Use violet-blue ink for text and marks; pure black does not belong in this paper world.

rules.name: The Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Pale blue and lavender may spread across the field, but saturated color remains concentrated in the seal and affirmative action.

rules.name: The Correspondence Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: Serif type speaks the invitation; sans-serif type handles guidance and choice.

rules.name: The One-Scene Rule
rules.body: Every route reads as one centered cinematic tableau, never as a conventional stacked landing page.

rules.name: The Projector-Light Rule
rules.body: Shadows stay cool, diffuse, and low-opacity; depth should feel like paper in soft light, never like a glossy app card.

rules.name: The Precise Geometry Rule
rules.body: Use folds, hairlines, diamonds, and film perforations as correspondence marks; avoid loose blobs or novelty romance icons.

rules.name: The Ceremonial Motion Rule
rules.body: Motion reveals the sequence—open, choose, walk home, remember—and never runs as unrelated decoration.

dos: Do preserve the first viewport as one floating sealed envelope with the quiet “轻点开启邀请” prompt.
Do keep the three-route story legible as open, choose, walk home, remember.
Do use cool paper gradients, violet ink, precise envelope construction, and small cinematic marks as the recurring visual language.
Do maintain keyboard focus, 48px touch targets, safe-area padding, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep supplied copy and real artwork replaceable without redesigning the surrounding correspondence.
donts: Don't turn the experience into a generic romance template with hearts, roses, red-pink gradients, or sugary decorative copy.
Don't replace the narrow, centered tableau with dashboard chrome, navigation, feature sections, or commercial event-page patterns.
Don't add visual noise around the envelope; its isolation is what makes the first click ceremonial.
Don't use harsh black, hard gray shadows, glass panels, or high-saturation accents that break the mist-blue paper world.
Don't make the playful refusal unsafe: it must remain visible, keyboard-operable, within viewport edges, and clear of the affirmative action.
